description: This file provides utility for asynchronously waiting with timeout handling. It defines a custom error type for timeout scenarios and a function that repeatedly polls a condition until it either becomes true or a timeout occurs.

classes.name: AsyncWaitTimeoutError
classes.description: A custom error type indicating a timeout waiting for a specific asynchronous condition.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: Asynchronously waits until a specified condition becomes true or a timeout occurs, polling at specified intervals.
